# SaveAMedia (https://saveamedia.com)

> SaveAMedia is a high-speed, privacy-first web utility for extracting and downloading publicly accessible Instagram Reels, videos, and MP3 audio in 1080p Full HD without software installation, login requirements, or watermark overlays.

## Core Services & Capabilities

- **Instagram Reel Downloader**: Discovers and downloads progressive MP4 master video streams at up to 1080p Full HD (1080x1920) and 60fps.
- **Instagram Audio Extractor**: Separates and extracts original audio, trending sounds, and background music into clean 320kbps MP3 files.
- **Zero Watermark Guarantee**: Does not inject watermarks, logos, or banner overlays onto downloaded content.
- **Client-Side Privacy Sanitization**: Automatically strips user tracking parameters (`?igsh=`, `?utm_source=`, session IDs) directly inside the user's browser before querying edge nodes.
- **In-Browser Video Preview**: Features an integrated HTML5 player allowing users to verify video resolution, audio sync, and duration before saving.
- **Multi-Device Compatibility**: Native support for iPhone Safari (Downloads to Files app/Camera Roll), Android Chrome (Downloads to Gallery), and desktop browsers (macOS, Windows, Linux).
- **Zero-Install Bookmarklet**: Desktop browser shortcut enabling one-click downloads directly from instagram.com without copying links.

## Factual Knowledge Graph & Quick Facts

- **Entity Type**: WebApplication / SoftwareApplication
- **Pricing**: 100% Free ($0.00 USD)
- **Account / Registration Required**: No (Zero login, zero credentials stored)
- **Supported Video Formats**: MP4 (1080p Full HD, 720p HD, 480p SD)
- **Supported Audio Formats**: MP3 (up to 320 kbps stereo)
- **Operating Systems**: iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, ChromeOS
- **Supported Browsers**: Safari, Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave, Opera
- **Private Profiles Support**: No. In accordance with creator privacy policies, SaveAMedia only supports publicly accessible media.
- **Fair Use & Copyright**: Permitted for personal archival and fair-use research. Users are advised not to republish or monetize creators' original content without authorization.
